written_before: any regime classifier was fitted and before any validation or sealed score was computed
observed_before_amending: only the label counts of the validation years 2012-2013: ACTIVE 9 positive cases, BREAK 2 positive cases (of 129 and 132 cases with a label). No score of any kind had been computed.
problem: The frozen rule selects C and the operating threshold on the validation years. For ACTIVE and BREAK those years hold too few positive cases for an AUC or a threshold to mean anything.
change: A task whose validation years hold fewer than 20 positive or fewer than 20 negative cases selects C by the mean leave-one-year-out AUC over the training years 2000-2011 and fixes its operating threshold on the pooled out-of-fold training scores. Tasks with enough validation cases are unchanged. Everything else in the protocol, including the sealed years, the verdict rule and the support gate, is unchanged.
owner_note: Recorded as a disclosed clarification under the owner's general instruction; the owner may withdraw it.
